newsitem.title: UK: Brit Biotech to drop Batimastat development.
newsitem.headline: Brit Biotech to drop Batimastat development.

text.p: Oxford-based research group British Biotech Plc said on Wednesday that it intended to drop development of anti-cancer agent, Batimastat.

In a statement the company said the injectable drug, which was its lead project at one stage, had a similar profile to the oral anti-cancer treatment Marimastat, which has now entered late stage clinical trials.
Analysts said the news on Batimastat, which was the group's lead product at one stage, had been well-flagged.

"Given the ease of Marimastat's administration by mouth, the success of Phase II trials in late-stage cancer patients and the commencement of Marimastat Phase III trials in lung cancer and shortly ovarian cancer, British Biotech has decided to discontinue development of Batimastat as an anti-cancer agent," the company said.
The statement coincided with the announcemnt of second-quarter results and detail of late-stage trials on its lead product, acute pancreatitis treatment Lexipafant.
